description.p: Beavyr displays molecules and trajectories at interactive frame rates, drives external quantum-chemistry programs, and reads back what they produce.

ul.li: Build and edit structures, with fragment attachment and a Z-matrix editor
Run geometry optimisations and frequency calculations through xTB or Behemoth
Normal modes with Eckart projection, animated, with a reaction-path option
Thermochemistry using Grimme's quasi-RRHO treatment of low-lying modes
IR and UV-Vis spectra, broadened and exportable
Molecular orbitals, electron density and spin density as isosurfaces from a Molden file
Read ORCA Hessians and gradients, and Gaussian frequency output
RMSD and Kabsch superposition between structures or trajectory frames

description.p: Beavyr links no quantum-chemistry code of its own. Each backend is an executable you point it at, run in a scratch directory and read back from its output files.
